question: What does the sea look like?
source: claude.ai design project b5ef80fc — Ocean Waves - Session 7.html
principles: Crest lines are offset copies of the coast, relaxing toward an open swell as they march seaward — in the map, iso-lines of the distance-from-shore field.
The feather comb rides the coast normal from each crest toward the next band, auto-capped by the band gap.
Two ink classes by stroke length: strong feathers and a faint under-comb.
Parked in-session: closed bays/lakes, wave interaction with islands, concave-inlet trimming.
